# Load data

```{r setup, include=T}
library(here)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(box.path = here())

box::use(
  r / load
)
box::reload(load)

library(tidyverse)
library(marginaleffects)
library(ggeffects)
library(ggpubr)

theme_set(theme_minimal())

z_transform <- function(x) as.vector(scale(x))

df <- load$regression_data()

count_before <- nrow(df)
df <- df |>
  group_by(channel) |>
  mutate(
    d_elite = elite,
    elite = z_transform(elite),
    d_pplcentr = pplcentr,
    pplcentr = z_transform(pplcentr),
    likes_per_view = video_likes / video_views
  ) |>
  filter(
    between(z_transform(video_views), -2.5, 2.5)
  ) |>
  ungroup()
count_after <- nrow(df)

print(paste("Removed", count_before - count_after, "outliers"))
```

# show descriptives

```{r}
df_summary <- df |>
  group_by(channel) |>
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    elite_mean = mean(d_elite),
    elite_sd = sd(d_elite),
    pplcentr_mean = mean(d_pplcentr),
    pplcentr_sd = sd(d_pplcentr),
    n_sents_mean = mean(n_sents),
    n_sents_sd = sd(n_sents)
  )

df_summary_long <- df_summary |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(elite_mean, elite_sd, pplcentr_mean, pplcentr_sd),
    names_to = c("var", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(elite|pplcentr)_(mean|sd)"
  )

print(df_summary, n=100)
```

```{r}
df |>
  drop_na(log_video_likes) |>
  group_by(channel) |>
  summarize(
    views_likes_cor = cor(log_video_views, log_video_likes)
  )

```

# define functions

```{r}
create_predictions <- function(formula, data, popvar) {

  model <- lm(formula, data = data)

  predictions <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(
    model = model,
    by = popvar,
    transform = exp,
    newdata = datagrid(
      model = model,
      !!!set_names(list(seq(-2, 2, 0.1)), popvar),
      grid_type = "counterfactual"
    )
  )

  return(predictions)
}
```

```{r}
create_plot <- function(df, var) {
  df_plot <- df |>
    left_join(df_summary_long, by = c("channel", "var")) |>
    mutate(new = (popvar * sd) + mean) |>
    filter(between(new, 0, 1))

  df_lines <- df_plot |>
    group_by(channel) |>
    slice_min(abs(new - 0), with_ties = FALSE) |>
    select(channel, intercept_y = estimate)

  df_plot |>
  ggplot(aes(x=new, y=estimate)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 4)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), alpha=0.1, linetype=2) +
    geom_hline(data = df_lines, aes(yintercept = intercept_y), color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    facet_wrap(~ channel, scales="free") +
    labs(
      title=paste("Average Marginal Effect of", var),
    ) +
    xlab(var)
}
```

# Regression on Video Likes

```{r}
channels <- df |>
  filter(channel != "FDP") |>
  select(channel) |>
  pull() |>
  unique()

elite_form <- formula(
  log_video_likes ~ elite + n_sents +released_year + elite:released_year
)

pplcentr_form <- formula(
  log_video_likes ~ pplcentr + n_sents + released_year + pplcentr:released_year
)

i <- 0
elite_preds <- list()
pplcentr_preds <- list()
for (channel in channels) {
  i <- i + 1

  df_channel <- df |>
    filter(channel==!!channel) |>
    select(log_video_views, log_video_likes, pplcentr, elite, released_year, log_n_sents, n_sents) |>
    drop_na()

  elite_preds[[i]] = create_predictions(elite_form, df_channel, "elite") |>
    mutate(channel = !!channel)
  pplcentr_preds[[i]] = create_predictions(pplcentr_form, df_channel, "pplcentr") |>
    mutate(channel = !!channel)

}
```
```{r}
df_elite <- elite_preds |>
  bind_rows() |>
  rename(popvar = elite) |>
  mutate(var = "elite")

df_pplcentr <- pplcentr_preds |>
  bind_rows() |>
  rename(popvar = pplcentr) |>
  mutate(var = "pplcentr")

df_pred <- df_elite |> bind_rows(df_pplcentr)
```



```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=11}
create_plot(df_elite, "Anti-Elitism")
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=11}
create_plot(df_pplcentr, "People-Centrism")
```
